body:
Opening the MRP produces:
```
WARNING: editor/editor_file_system.cpp:1352 - UID duplicate detected between res://tilesets/iso_32x32/continent.png and res://tilesets/dev2/__continent.png.
WARNING: editor/editor_file_system.cpp:1352 - UID duplicate detected between res://tilesets/iso_32x32/desert_layer.png and res://tilesets/dev2/__desert_layer.png.
WARNING: editor/editor_file_system.cpp:1352 - UID duplicate detected between res://tilesets/iso_32x32/features.png and res://tilesets/dev2/__features.png.
WARNING: editor/editor_file_system.cpp:1352 - UID duplicate detected between res://tilesets/iso_32x32/grass_layer.png and res://tilesets/dev2/__grass_layer.png.
```
I'm guessing you've created `res://tilesets/dev2`/`res://tilesets/iso_32x32` by copying the other folder with all the contents, including the `.import` files containing the UIDs (hence the duplicated/conflicting UIDs)? 🤔
I've tried such folder-copy-pasting. After the new files got reimported the `.import` files got their `path`, `source_file`, `dest_file` updated, but the copied `uid` remained unchanged. Same as in the MRP.

E.g. both these have `uid="uid://bmxgrq3br83dn"`:
```diff
diff --git a/./tilesets/iso_32x32/continent.png.import b/./tilesets/dev2/__continent.png.import
index 84b0a15..b630560 100644
--- a/./tilesets/iso_32x32/continent.png.import
+++ b/./tilesets/dev2/__continent.png.import
@@ -3,15 +3,15 @@
 importer="texture"
 type="CompressedTexture2D"
 uid="uid://bmxgrq3br83dn"
-path="res://.godot/imported/continent.png-e4c59f98241fb2785b397218594b0e57.ctex"
+path="res://.godot/imported/__continent.png-9fed235ef6a1a586eace143fcfd16a8e.ctex"
 metadata={
 "vram_texture": false
 }
 
 [deps]
 
-source_file="res://tilesets/iso_32x32/continent.png"
-dest_files=["res://.godot/imported/continent.png-e4c59f98241fb2785b397218594b0e57.ctex"]
+source_file="res://tilesets/dev2/__continent.png"
+dest_files=["res://.godot/imported/__continent.png-9fed235ef6a1a586eace143fcfd16a8e.ctex"]
 
 [params]
 
```

---

However, even with unresolved UID duplicates (which got warned about), the `res://scenes/tile_map_generator.tscn` file references the textures used by TileSetAtlasSources as UID+path:
```
[ext_resource type="Texture2D" uid="uid://bmxgrq3br83dn" path="res://tilesets/iso_32x32/continent.png" id="4_ulob4"]
[ext_resource type="Texture2D" uid="uid://d12f365cjwii8" path="res://tilesets/iso_32x32/desert_layer.png" id="5_2xoct"]
[ext_resource type="Texture2D" uid="uid://bq3rsjojodk1i" path="res://tilesets/iso_32x32/grass_layer.png" id="6_ixy6n"]
[ext_resource type="Texture2D" uid="uid://bdb13wbofshd" path="res://tilesets/iso_32x32/features.png" id="7_jw8u0"]
```
Yet, after removal of `.godot` directory it seems to end up loading incorrect textures (same UID but different path). This definitely looks like a bug.

---

As a solution/workaround you'd need to get rid of UID conflicts.
E.g. you can remove `uid=...` lines from the `.import` files for the old/unused textures so they'd get a new UID on reimport. Can be done before removing `.godot` folder, or after removing `.godot` folder but before reopening the project.
Deleting those UIDs in the .import files and then updating the values in the Tilesets seems to have worked for me.
@KoBeWi Is automatically replacing the duplicate UIDs from `.import` files something we'd want to add a fix for, or should this remain a manual workaround?

It is possible to assign a new UID in case of a conflict, the problem is which file should get a new UID. The editor is not aware which file is the original and checking modified time is difficult, because it depends on format (the UID can be either inside the file, in `.import` or `.uid`). Manual workaround is the most feasible option, we can make the warning more prominent e.g. by showing a toast or a warning dialog.
